title: Add the Apache-2.0 license to TermAl, matching Engram
outcome: TermAl is licensed under Apache-2.0, as Engram is. The repository has the canonical license text, the package metadata declares it, and the README states it.
acceptance: LICENSE at the repository root contains the canonical Apache License 2.0 text, byte-identical to Engram's LICENSE (the same sha256, recorded in a holder note).

Cargo.toml's [package] declares license = "Apache-2.0"; ui/package.json declares "license": "Apache-2.0" ("private": true is kept); README.md gains a License section stating that TermAl's code and documentation are licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (linked to LICENSE) unless stated otherwise, and that third-party components keep their own licenses. No other file changes.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Added the canonical Apache-2.0 license, package metadata, and README license notice in commit 67a42eba2000c86fdf058700b8e4fbfdf87a05be. Independent acceptance evaluation ccbd97df6b644c409ffcac423aec79ac passed 3/3; exact-tree full gate test-65edb6ef passed 5/5. Opus2 verified the fast-forward push and origin/master at the commit; no install was performed.
